response.original_title: 【Booking Help】 How can I add an additional room to my Carnival cruise?
response.overview: You can add a room to an existing Carnival Cruises booking by calling Carnival Cruise Customer Service at +1-855-526-0470 or contacting your travel agent. To add rooms to a Carnival Cruise, you must call Carnival Cruise directly at ☎️ +1-855-526-0470(US/Canada) or +1-855-526-0470(UK) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Additions depend on stateroom capacity, ship lifeboat capacity, and current availability ☎️ +1-855-526-0470(US/Canada) or +1-855-526-0470(UK). The booking will likely be re-priced at current rates. To add someone to an existing Carnival Cruise room, you must call Carnival Cruise directly at ☎️ +1-855-526-0470(US/Canada) or +1-855-526-0470(UK), or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done via the website or app.
